June, 2025
Author: Alok Kumar Verma

Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 In The High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Alok Kumar Verma
 05th June, 2025
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 565 Of 2025
Sumit Singh and Another ..... Applicants
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand .....Respondent
Counsel for the Applicants : Mr. Gaurav Singh,
 Advocate.

entities.text:
High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Pradeep Lohani,
 Brief Holder.

Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
This is an Application for anticipatory bail under Sections 376(2)(n), 504 and Section 506 of the
Indian Penal Code, 1860 in Case Crime No.201 of 2025, registered at Police Station Sidcul,
District Haridwar.
2.  According to the First Information Report dated 26.04.2025, the applicant no.1 had proposed to the informant to marry her.
He (applicant no.1) gave her intoxicant in a hotel on 31.01.2023 and established physical relations with her.
He also made an obscene video of her.
His father (applicant no.2) also tried to take advantage by showing her the video.
3. Heard Mr. Gaurav Singh, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. Pradeep Lohani, learned Brief Holder for the respondent.
4. On 23.05.2025, the learned counsel for the State sought time to get instructions.

Today, Mr.
Pradeep Lohani, Brief Holder, has sought three weeks' time to file objection to the anticipatory bail application.
6. Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate, contended that the informant and the applicant no.1 were good friends.
Applicant no.1 has not established any physical relation with Sumit Singh And Another ..... ... vs State Of Uttarakhand on 5 June, 2025

entities.text: Sumit Singh And Another ..... ... vs State Of Uttarakhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
7. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicants Sumit Singh and Anand Singh, they shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/-
and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicants shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and they shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicants shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.

8. List on 10.07.2025 for hearing on the anticipatory bail application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Date:05.06.2025 Shiv/
